entities.summary: PT Nusantara Media Mandiri, commonly known as Nusantara TV, is an Indonesian digital national network based in East Jakarta. It is owned by NT Corp. NTV launched on November 10, 2015  and obtained a permanent broadcasting permit (IPP) from the Indonesian government in 2019.
